resources.string: Let devices you pair view this phone’s screen and perform actions you request. Screen content and actions are encrypted between this phone and your device. Turn off remote access in the app to stop connections.

Save this phone’s PIN for remote unlocking. It stays encrypted on this phone and is available while locked after the first local unlock following a restart. Allow unlocking separately for each device. A failed attempt requires local recovery.

Pairing and unlock configuration is protected while unrestricted remote control is off. Change these settings on this phone, or turn on unrestricted remote control in Settings. Back and Home still work remotely.
